_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Rabindranath Tagore (1861-1941) as translator: Songs of Kabir (with Evelyn Underhill, 1915) and The Crescent Moon (1913), his own Bengali poems in his own English. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 33); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
